method: Lock the post-#379 main canonical snapshot and reconstruct the May closing state from all 214 May-dated canonical cards because no official May Monthly Brief exists.
Use May as the sole previous-month baseline for June delta formation; classify June flows as deepened, advanced, operationalized or expanded rather than treating already-present May signals as new.
Review all 197 June cards and all 99 June top/high cards after the independent external gap closure, while preserving the June-only public reference contract.
Apply a hindsight firewall: July, August and September events or later Monthly Brief conclusions are not evidence for the June thesis and may only be used as red-team context.
Separate contract, financing, construction, commissioning and COD; announced GW/GWh is never treated as installed capacity.
Treat AI/data-center demand as a selective power-infrastructure pull already visible in May, not a new June master cause.
Apply a strict SBTL pouch lens: no pouch-film demand inference without form-factor, customer-program or supply-contract evidence.
Require every public June reference to preserve the locked canonical title/date and use a governed title-supporting URL.

independent_external_deep_dive.editorial_effect: The external June sweep remains additive to the chronological May→June comparison. It strengthens the evidence that May bankability/LDES/AI signals deepened in June through more differentiated revenue-contract structures and more explicit policy architecture, while recycled-material certification operationalizes a May circularity direction and Ford-CATL production-intent test cells provide an execution/validation example of the technology-transfer/localization axis already present in May. It does not make AI a new or singular June master narrative.

previous_month_baseline.reconstruction_basis: article-date May canonical universe in the same locked post-#379 snapshot

baseline_state.theme: ESS bankability and execution already present
baseline_state.finding: May already contained project-financing closes, minimum-revenue/optimization structures, utility-scale COD, large ESS supply contracts, and 20-year fixed-revenue storage contracts in Japan.

baseline_state.theme: Long-duration procurement and storage policy already present
baseline_state.finding: May already showed multi-GWh long-duration procurement and preliminary storage-market rule design, so June LDES evidence is a deepening of an existing direction.
AI-linked storage/infrastructure cases appeared in May; June evidence reinforces and broadens this pull but does not originate it.

baseline_state.theme: Next-generation technology already showed uneven maturity by technology
baseline_state.finding: May sodium-ion already included a three-year 60GWh supply contract, a Q4 mass-production plan and a commissioned 100MW/200MWh sodium BESS; Energy Dome CO₂ storage already had a commercialization-path discussion; solid-state remained short of full demonstration. June sodium-ion is therefore a product-specific follow-up, CO₂ moves from commercialization discussion to signed tolling/commercial agreements, solid-state road testing is a clearer stage advance, and iron-air remains a June-only new-contract signal.

baseline_state.theme: Supply-chain policy already included company- and transaction-level proposals, responses and financing
baseline_state.finding: May combined macro concentration/mineral risk with company- and transaction-level signals, but their legal/execution stages differed: EU public-procurement / financial-support eligibility and foreign-investment conditions were Commission proposals under Parliament/Council review, while FEOC-linked ownership restructuring and named U.S. policy financing were concrete company-level responses/financing. June adds different named-company lists, considered support tools and EV-cell production finance rather than introducing transaction-level instruments for the first time.

Korea had already established recycled-material production/use certification and full-lifecycle tracking as policy directions in May; June advances these areas into pilot implementation and real-data validation.

hindsight_firewall.permitted_later_use: red-team only; no July-August-September event may establish or upgrade a June claim

delta_classification.june_change: June adds different revenue-contract forms—5-year/20-year tolling and a 20-year capacity contract—while tax-equity financing and COD remain continuing execution evidence. The delta is structural differentiation, not longer contract duration.

delta_classification.may_state: LDES procurement and AI-linked ESS demand were already visible.
delta_classification.june_change: Duration, provisional LDES selection, non-binding EU deployment pledges and power-system strategy make the demand architecture more differentiated.

delta_classification.may_state: Sodium-ion already had a 60GWh supply contract, Q4 mass-production plan and a commissioned 100MW/200MWh BESS; Energy Dome CO₂ storage already had a commercialization-path discussion; solid-state remained pre-full-demonstration. The May baseline does not establish an iron-air progression anchor.
delta_classification.june_change: CATL sodium-ion delivery scheduling is a product-specific follow-up; Energy Dome CO₂ storage advances from commercialization discussion to signed tolling/commercial agreements; solid-state road testing is a clearer stage advance; iron-air remains a separate June-only new-contract signal.

delta_classification.may_state: Macro concentration/mineral risk coexisted with company/transaction-level signals at different stages: EU public-procurement / financial-support eligibility and foreign-investment conditions were Commission proposals under Parliament/Council review, while FEOC-linked ownership restructuring and named policy financing were concrete responses/financing.
delta_classification.june_change: June adds a different mix of named-company export/procurement lists, considered G7 support tools and EU EV-cell production finance. The delta is diversification of transaction-level instruments and execution forms, not first-time appearance of binding EU rules.

delta_classification.may_state: Localization already included production-footprint/supply-chain themes, recycled-material production/use certification, lifecycle tracking, and foreign-investment conditions that explicitly included joint ventures and technology transfer.
delta_classification.june_change: Korea certification piloting and Japan passport real-data validation operationalize existing circularity/traceability directions; Ford production-intent test cells show an existing CATL technology-licensing structure being applied in manufacturing validation. June is operationalization of existing localization axes, not evidence that a new rights axis first appeared.
